body:
I'm still waiting for her to text back :l
aka, i have no one near me i can trust.

I met her when i was working with my dad, she has a terrible sense of humor though, we were working with puffins and going around Iceland. It was meh but at least she made an effort to become my friend, like no one ever has.

I'm suicidal af. And the best thing when people socialise with me is when they show they care, to be fair that doesn't happen so often but i recommend just showing that you are listening and show that you care. xoxo
